title: Seven Palms Reunion | KEY.co
description_expanded: Outside, the property transforms into a private resort-style oasis centered around a stunning pool and beautifully designed outdoor living spaces. A summer kitchen and covered lanai create the perfect backdrop for open-air dining, while the surrounding lounge areas invite long afternoons under the Florida sun. Inside, entertainment continues with a lively game room, a dedicated home theater, and multiple gathering spaces designed for both relaxation and fun. The top level reveals a spectacular open-air terrace with Gulf views and a cozy fireplace, offering a breathtaking setting to unwind after a day at the beach. Thoughtfully designed for large groups, this exceptional home delivers an inspiring blend of comfort, style, and coastal adventure. Tucked away in the heart of Inlet Beach, this newly constructed coastal retreat offers an extraordinary setting for unforgettable gatherings along the Emerald Coast. Spanning three spacious levels with convenient elevator access, the home blends warm natural wood accents with bright coastal design, creating a refined yet welcoming atmosphere. Sunlight pours through expansive windows, illuminating the open living spaces where a chef’s kitchen, large dining area, and comfortable lounge invite effortless connection and relaxation. Just a short stroll from the beach, the home also includes bikes and a golf cart, making it easy to explore the charming nearby cafés, boutiques, and scenic coastal paths.
rooms_guidance: Bedroom 2 - Second Floor: King + Single Over Single Bunk
Bedroom 4 - Second Floor: Two Queen Over Queen Bunks + Single Over Single Bunk
Bedroom 6 - Third Floor: Four Queen Over Queen Bunks
